19899-the-honour-of-the-flag.title: The Flag
19899-the-honour-of-the-flag.creator: Unknown
19899-the-honour-of-the-flag.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This man had for many years carried on a flourishing trade in the east end of London. Having got together as much money as he might suppose would supply his daily needs, he built himself a villa near the pleasant little town of Erith. His house overlooked the water; in front of it sloped a considerable piece of garden ground.

71024-the-man-she-hated.title: Won By Strategy
71024-the-man-she-hated.creator: MRS. ALEX. McVEIGH MILLER
71024-the-man-she-hated.description: A book by MRS. ALEX. McVEIGH MILLER. In this factory a large number of women and girls were employed, and Fairfax Fielding, who had come here at twelve years old, as an errand girl, at three dollars per week, was in her apprenticeship to the business now, and earning her seven dollars per week at the sewing machine. She was seventeen years old, and if she stayed until she was twenty she would earn double that sum.

arxiv-2202-13247.title: On applications of Herglotz-Nevanlinna functions in material sciences, I: classical theory and applications of sum rules
arxiv-2202-13247.creator: Annemarie Luger, Miao-Jung Yvonne Ou
arxiv-2202-13247.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Annemarie Luger, Miao-Jung Yvonne Ou. This is the first part of the review article which focuses on theory and applications of Herglotz-Nevanlinna functions in material sciences. It starts with the definition of scalar valued Herglotz-Nevanlinna functions and explains in detail the theorems that are pertinent to applications, followed by a short overview of the matrix-valued and operator-valued versions of these functions and the properties that carry over from scalar cases.

arxiv-2205-00482.creator: Paolo Lisca, Andrea Parma

arxiv-2309-02557.title: Sparse Partitioning Around Medoids
arxiv-2309-02557.creator: Lars Lenssen, Erich Schubert
arxiv-2309-02557.description: Abstract Partitioning Around Medoids (PAM, k k -Medoids) is a popular clustering technique to use with arbitrary distance functions or similarities, where each cluster is represented by its most central object, called the medoid or the discrete median. In operations research, this family of problems is also known as facility location problem (FLP).

arxiv-2310-03325.title: Learning Concept-Based Causal Transition and Symbolic Reasoning for Visual Planning
arxiv-2310-03325.creator: Yilue Qian, Peiyu Yu, Ying Nian Wu, Yao Su, Wei Wang, Lifeng Fan
arxiv-2310-03325.description: Abstract Visual planning simulates how humans make decisions to achieve desired goals in the form of searching for visual causal transitions between an initial visual state and a final visual goal state. It has become increasingly important in egocentric vision with its advantages in guiding agents to perform daily tasks in complex environments.

arxiv-2403-02057.title: Revisiting fixed-point quantum search: proof of the quasi-Chebyshev lemma
arxiv-2403-02057.creator: Guanzhong Li, Lvzhou Li
arxiv-2403-02057.description: Abstract The original Grover’s algorithm suffers from the souffle problem, which means that the success probability of quantum search decreases dramatically if the iteration time is too small or too large from the right time. To overcome the souffle problem, the fixed-point quantum search with an optimal number of queries was proposed [Phys. Rev. Lett.

arxiv-2406-11126.title: Mitigating the binary viewing angle bias for standard sirens
arxiv-2406-11126.creator: Alberto Salvarese, Hsin-Yu Chen
arxiv-2406-11126.description: Abstract The inconsistency between experiments in the measurements of the local Universe expansion rate, the Hubble constant, suggests unknown systematics in the existing experiments or new physics. Gravitational-wave standard sirens, a method to independently provide direct measurements of the Hubble constant, have the potential to address this tension.

arxiv-2408-04913.title: Knowledge Base Embeddings: Semantics and Theoretical Properties
arxiv-2408-04913.creator: Camille Bourgaux, Ricardo Guimarães, Raoul Koudijs, Victor Lacerda, Ana Ozaki
arxiv-2408-04913.description: Abstract Research on knowledge graph embeddings has recently evolved into knowledge base embeddings, where the goal is not only to map facts into vector spaces but also constrain the models so that they take into account the relevant conceptual knowledge available.

arxiv-2408-11689.title: Fine-structure changing collisions in 87 Rb upon D2 excitation in the hyperfine Paschen-Back regime
arxiv-2408-11689.creator: Clare R Higgins, Danielle Pizzey and Ifan G Hughes
arxiv-2408-11689.description: Abstract We investigate fine structure changing collisions in 87 Rb vapour upon D2 excitation in a thermal vapour at 350 K; the atoms are placed in a 0.6 T axial magnetic field in order to gain access to the hyperfine Pashen-Back regime.

arxiv-2409-15846.title: Potential Fields as Scene Affordance for Behavior Change-Based Visual Risk Object Identification Thanks: Corresponding Author.
arxiv-2409-15846.creator: Pang-Yuan Pao, Shu-Wei Lu, Ze-Yan Lu, Yi-Ting ChenDepartment of Computer ScienceNational Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
arxiv-2409-15846.description: Abstract We study behavior change-based visual risk object identification (Visual-ROI), a critical framework designed to detect potential hazards for intelligent driving systems. Existing methods often show significant limitations in spatial accuracy and temporal consistency, stemming from an incomplete understanding of scene affordance. For example, these methods frequently misidentify vehicles that do not impact the ego vehicle as risk objects.

arxiv-2410-21029.title: FairStream: Fair Multimedia Streaming Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning Agents
arxiv-2410-21029.creator: Jannis Weil, Jonas Ringsdorf, Julian Barthel, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Tobias Meuser
arxiv-2410-21029.description: Abstract Multimedia streaming accounts for the majority of traffic in today’s internet. Mechanisms like adaptive bitrate streaming control the bitrate of a stream based on the estimated bandwidth, ideally resulting in smooth playback and a good qoe ( qoe ). However, selecting the optimal bitrate is challenging under volatile network conditions.

arxiv-2412-18610.title: Crosscap Quenches and Entanglement Evolution
arxiv-2412-18610.creator: Zixia Wei
arxiv-2412-18610.description: Abstract Understanding the mechanisms by which complex correlations emerge through the dynamics of quantum many-body systems remains a fundamental challenge in modern physics. To address this, quench dynamics starting from nonthermal states have been extensively studied, leading to significant progress.

arxiv-2512-02708.title: Spectropolarimetric characterisation of exoplanet host stars in preparation of the A ​ r ​ i ​ e ​ l Ariel mission
arxiv-2512-02708.creator: S. Bellotti, A. Lavail, D. Evensberget, A. A. Vidotto, C. Danielski, B. Edwards, G. A. J. Hussain, T. Lüftinger, J. Morin, P. Petit, S. Boro Saikia, G. Micela, A. López Ariste
arxiv-2512-02708.description: Abstract Aims. We update the status of the spectropolarimetric campaign dedicated to characterise the magnetic field properties of a sample of known exoplanet-hosting stars included in the current target list of the A ​ r ​ i ​ e ​ l Ariel mission.

arxiv-2602-23792.title: Divide and Conquer: Accelerating Diffusion-Based Large Language Models via Adaptive Parallel Decoding
arxiv-2602-23792.creator: Xiangzhong Luo, Yilin An, Zhicheng Yu, Weichen Liu, Xu Yang
arxiv-2602-23792.description: Abstract Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have shown promising performance across various reasoning tasks, establishing themselves as an alternative to autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Unlike autoregressive LLMs that generate one token per step based on all previous tokens, dLLMs theoretically enable parallel generation of multiple tokens at each decoding step.

pmc-10552427.title: Slik maintains tissue homeostasis by preventing JNK-mediated apoptosis
pmc-10552427.creator: Chenglin Li, Xiaojie Zhu, Xinyue Sun, Xiaowei Guo, Wenzhe Li, Ping Chen, Yulii V Shidlovskii, Qian Zhou, Lei Xue
pmc-10552427.description: BackgroundThe c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK) pathway is an evolutionarily conserved regulator of cell death, which is essential for coordinating tissue homeostasis. In this study, we have characterized the Drosophila Ste20-like kinase Slik as a novel modulator of JNK pathway-mediated apoptotic cell death.ResultsFirst, ectopic JNK signaling-triggered cell death is enhanced by slik depletion whereas suppressed by Slik overexpression.

pmc-11442367.title: Intentional looks facilitate faster responding in observers
pmc-11442367.creator: Florence Mayrand, Sarah D McCrackin, Jelena Ristic
pmc-11442367.description: Humans construct rich representations of other people’s mental states. Here we investigated how intentionality in eye gaze affected perception and responses to gaze. Observers viewed videos of human gazers looking left or right. Unbeknownst to the observers, the gazers could either choose where to look (self-chosen gaze) or were explicitly instructed where to look (computer-instructed gaze).

pmc-11503437.title: Combined Effects of Environmental Metals and Physiological Stress on Lipid Dysregulation
pmc-11503437.creator: Emmanuel Obeng-Gyasi, Yvonne R Ford, Antoni Torres
pmc-11503437.description: Background: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are a leading cause of mortality worldwide, influenced by genetic, environmental, and behavioral factors. This study examines the relationship between heavy metal exposure, chronic physiological stress (allostatic load), and lipid profiles, which are markers of CVD risk, using data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017–2018.

pmc-12357598.title: Association of Heavy Smoking With High Body Mass Index and Cardiovascular Risk Score in Japan
pmc-12357598.creator: Katsushi Takeda, Daisuke Aotani, Hiroya Hashimoto, Keiko Hamada, Chie Hasegawa, Yuki Shimizu, Yusuke Kuga, Takemasa Ando, Takashi Yagi, Hiroyuki Koyama, Hiroshi Takagi, Shigehiro Shiraki, Takashi Yokochi, Takeshi Kamiya, Hiromi Kataoka, Tomohiro Tanaka
pmc-12357598.description: ObjectiveAlthough smoking, an established cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk, is a modifier of body mass index (BMI), studies are still lacking addressing a potential association between smoking and BMI or BMI‐related risk factors in Asia. The aim of this study was to investigate the association between smoking and BMI or CVD risk factors in a working‐age population in Japan.

pmc-12491409.title: Nanoimprinted polyamide membranes for ultrafast and precise molecular sieving with low fouling
pmc-12491409.creator: Pengrui Jin, Zhao Yang, Frederik Ceyssens, Jiakuan Yang, Shushan Yuan, Huanting Wang
pmc-12491409.description: Polyamide membranes with ultrahigh permeance and exceptional solute selectivity present a significant opportunity to reduce energy consumption in desalination, pharmaceutical purification, and solvent recovery. We report a nanomolding phase inversion strategy for constructing high-resolution pillar-array patterns on a nanofibrous Kevlar hydrogel support, enabling controlled interfacial polymerization (IP) of polyamide active layers with pillar-arrayed structures.

pmc-12827743.title: Effect of evidence-based education program with mentoring system for prevention of ventilator-associated pneumonia on nurses’ competency to improve quality care for patients in the intensive care unit: a quasi-experimental study in a tertiary hospital in Bangladesh
pmc-12827743.creator: Nahida Akhter, Xintong Zhou, Sameh Elhabashy, K. A. T. M. Ehsanul Huq, Miho Okamoto, Md. Abdul Latif, Abdulfatai Olamilekan Babaita, Michiko Moriyama
pmc-12827743.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNurses’ skills, knowledge, practice, motivation, and work engagement are crucial for achieving better outcomes in intensive care unit (ICU) patients. Evidence-based in-service training and monitoring of nurses’ behavior can significantly enhance the quality of care for ICU patients.

pmc-13145107.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1946 VIRTUAL REALITY APPLIED TO POST-STROKE REHABILITATION: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE NEUROREHAB VR SOFTWARE
pmc-13145107.creator: Mercedes Gil-Rodriguez, Laura Amaya-Pascasio, Alba Hernández-Martínez, Marta Rodríguez-Camacho, Máriam Ramos-Teodoro, Andrea Rodríguez-Solana, Sofia Carrilho-Candeias, Manuel Fernández, Andrea Orellana-Jaén, Antonio Rodríguez, Laura Del Olmo-Iruela, Belén Castro-Ropero, Villegas Rodriguez Inmaculada
pmc-13145107.description: Background and aimsTo describe the design and development of NeuroRehab VR, a fully immersive, specific and gamified virtual reality (VR) software aimed at improving the quality of life and reducing disability in post-stroke patients.MethodsThe project was structured into three phases (preproduction, production, and postproduction) following SCRUM methodology.

pmc-13195418.title: Facile synthesis of (4-phenylthiophen-2-yl)methyl 1-naphthoates via Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling: anti-seizure evaluation through molecular docking, EEG analysis, and ADMET profiling
pmc-13195418.creator: Nayab Mohsin, Nasir Rasool, Aqsa Kanwal, Khaled Ahmed Saghir, Imran Imran, Farhan Siddique, Sumaira Nadeem, Muhammad Imran
pmc-13195418.description: This study focused on the synthesis of a novel series of (4-bromothiophen-2-yl)methyl 1-naphthoate derivatives (5a–5h) via the Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling with moderate to excellent yields. Acute pentylenetetrazol (PTZ) and 6 Hz psychomotor seizure models were used to investigate in vivo anticonvulsant effects. The 5b, 5d, and 5h showed significant outcomes concerning mortality, protection, and seizure severity.

pmc-13243621.title: Simulation-driven experiments resolve throttle pedal vibration issues
pmc-13243621.creator: Xinxing Liu, Fuwu Yan, Xiaorong Li, Pinbin Zhao, Yuhu Cheng
pmc-13243621.description: This study investigates the resolution of accelerator pedal vibration issues during horn activation in vehicle tuning through finite element analysis combined with real-world test data. For certain facelift models experiencing NVH challenges with pedal vibrations upon horn usage, simulation identified a pedal bracket modal frequency of 355.

pmc-13484460.title: Digital workflow integration and standardized communication protocols in prosthetic dentistry: a multicenter cross-sectional study on innovation impact and interdisciplinary collaboration
pmc-13484460.creator: Daniela Popa, Marius Negucioiu, Tudor Secasan, Andreea Kui, Andrea Chisnoiu, Alexandra Similea, Codruţa Popescu, Smaranda Buduru
pmc-13484460.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe digitalization of prosthetic dentistry — encompassing CAD/CAM fabrication, intraoral scanning, and digital prescription platforms — represents one of the most transformative biotechnological shifts in contemporary dental practice. Despite these advances, the transition from analog to digital communication workflows remains incomplete in many clinical settings, and the relationship between communication modality, error frequency, and professional satisfaction has not been quantified in a multicenter international sample.

pmc-13531492.title: Impact of structured medication reviews on prescribing in English primary care: a retrospective observational cohort study
pmc-13531492.creator: James P Sheppard, Paul A Bateman, Cynthia Wright-Drakesmith, Christopher Elles Clark, Rebecca K Barnes, Andrew Paul Clegg, Gary A Ford, Seema Gadhia, William Hinton, FD Richard Hobbs, Sundus Jawad, Kamlesh Khunti, Gregory YH Lip, Simon de Lusignan, Jonathan Mant, Deborah McCahon, Bernardo Meza-Torres, Rupert A Payne, Rafael Perera-Salazar, Claire Reidy, Anna Seeley, Samuel Seidu, Katherine Tucker, Rik van der Veen, Marney Williams, Richard J McManus

pmc-13672694.title: LLM‐Assisted Design of Ultralow‐κ Chalcogenides
pmc-13672694.creator: Yujie Liu, Congran Jia, Yuzhou Hao, Xuejie Li, Yang Wang, Artem Oganov, Jun Sun, Xiangdong Ding, Turab Lookman, Zhibin Gao
pmc-13672694.description: Accelerating the discovery of materials with extreme lattice thermal conductivity (κ) is limited by the high cost of first‐principles screening. Here, we develop an LLM‐assisted low‐κ discovery workflow, where Bayesian optimization (BO) proposes candidates, an LLM performs evidence‐conditioned re‐ranking, and physics‐based structure generation, stability validation, and κ calculations serve as the acceptance criteria.
